purpose: Test a fixed candidate-aware physical re-association rule on the already executed foreground-mass anonymous streams before any predicted-track training.
selection: Use the existing fixed policy_train_pseudo ten-video subset and independent development_pseudo first-eight prefix; no score, GT, output, or metric selection.

algorithm.event_order: source-frame ascending; native track ID ascending within a frame
algorithm.birth_rule: At a native-track birth, match only against persistent states whose last observation is in an earlier source frame and within the fixed gap horizon.
algorithm.association: One-to-one Hungarian maximization of box IoU; accept only IoU >= 0.5.
algorithm.parameter_selection: Fixed before this diagnostic from the existing COVTrack IoU convention and one-frame causal bridge; no GT tuning or sweep.

interpretation: This is a category-free causal physical-stream mechanism diagnostic. It cannot establish OCD/MOT performance, frontend qualification, predicted-track training readiness, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
